phkdRules: Separate verified facts from research hypotheses.

partitions.name: Unicode Scripts
partitions.rule: Rows generated from UCD Script property values only.

partitions.name: Historic Scripts
partitions.rule: Encoded historic scripts use UCD; unencoded historic scripts stay UNENCODED with scholarly evidence.

partitions.name: Liturgical Scripts
partitions.rule: Liturgical status is cultural metadata, separate from Unicode encoding.

partitions.name: Undeciphered Systems
partitions.rule: DISPUTED or SCHOLARLY; no OCR/transliteration/runtime claims.

partitions.name: Shorthand Systems
partitions.rule: Encoded systems use UCD; unencoded systems remain UNENCODED.

partitions.name: Notation Systems
partitions.rule: Notation blocks are symbol/notation records, not Script property inventions.

partitions.name: HKD Extensions
partitions.rule: Private/research rows cannot claim Unicode or ISO assignment.

tables.name: script_registry
tables.purpose: Canonical 426-row script-system registry; PHKD fact fields stay UNKNOWN unless sourced.

tables.name: script_alternate_name
tables.purpose: Alternate script names, aliases, source spellings.

tables.name: script_extension_value
tables.purpose: Script_Extensions aliases from UCD where applicable.

tables.name: script_character_inventory
tables.purpose: Vowels, consonants, matras, ligatures, punctuation, symbols.

tables.name: script_digit_inventory
tables.purpose: Digits 0-9 and zero glyph per source.

tables.name: script_font_support
tables.purpose: Font registry join with support posture.

tables.name: script_lineage_edge
tables.purpose: Family tree and hypothesis lineage edges with evidence status.

tables.name: script_evidence_ref
tables.purpose: Evidence bundle references and claim boundaries.

tables.name: script_provenance_event
tables.purpose: Immutable provenance events for field-level changes.

invariants: Every Script node must have at least one EvidenceSource edge.
Research hypotheses must use evidence_status DISPUTED or DRAFT, never VERIFIED.
No UnicodeBlock edge may exist unless the block name exists in Blocks.txt or the edge is marked UNKNOWN.

failClosedFilters: exclude records where evidence_status=unknown unless includeResearch=true

kbsOntology.evidenceModel: Every assertion is a claim edge with source_ref, provenance_event, evidence_status, review_state, and generated_at.

contracts.guard: requires verified evidence and render/transliteration coverage

scriptFamilyTrees.note: Required family graph from user prompt; remains draft until edge-level scholarly sources are attached.

glyphRegistry.model: Glyph records are separated from script records; glyphs require code point/provenance/font-render proof before runtime use.

evidenceRegistry.rule: A record can be search-visible in draft, but runtime-enabled only after verified evidence and required render/transliteration checks pass.

migrationPlan: Create read-only architecture artifacts and PHKD validation tests.
Ingest official Unicode UCD files into data/unicode/ucd-latest with sha256 provenance.
Create script_registry and companion tables in SQLite/PostgreSQL.
Backfill all Unicode Script property rows from PropertyValueAliases/Scripts/Blocks/DerivedAge.
Load non-Unicode research rows as draft/unknown/unencoded records.
Reserve remaining capacity as hkd_private evidence slots with no runtime claims.
Attach field-level provenance and source_refs for every row.
Keep hkd_runtime_enabled=false until evidence, rendering, font, transliteration, and review gates pass.
Expose API/search/KBS surfaces behind includeResearch and evidence-status filters.
Only then migrate selected verified records into active Lipi runtime surfaces.
validationRules: registry_index must be unique and between 1 and 426.
id must be unique and stable.
source_refs must contain at least one source id.
provenance must be present for every row.
unicode_status=encoded or partially_encoded requires either unicode_ranges or a non-Unicode symbol/notation block source.
unicode_status=unencoded requires empty unicode_script_alias or UNKNOWN unless a Unicode property row has no assigned range.
iso15924 must be UNKNOWN unless copied from an authoritative source field.
hkd_runtime_enabled=true requires evidence_status=verified and no UNKNOWN in required rendering/transliteration gates.
undeciphered systems must not expose transliteration/OCR/translation runtime claims.
